videos.desc: In a snowy-log-cabin living room a woman throws a huge chunky knit blanket over herself on the sofa and snuggles in; a man walks up, she opens the blanket, and they end up wrapped in it together holding mugs of tea.
videos.said: Warm at last! Share the cover!

videos.desc: In a cozy wooden cabin a hand lights a tall candle on the dinner table with a match; a couple leans in to admire the warm glow, then they blow it out together and watch the thin trail of smoke rise.
videos.said: What a warm glow. Make a wish.

videos.desc: A 3D-animated couple pushes a big rolled-up green carpet across an empty room until it unrolls over the wooden floor; they crawl onto it, flop down on the soft pile with happy sighs and high-five.

A woman tries out a new teal swivel chair at a desk: she sits down, sinks into the cushion, leans the backrest far back, spins a full circle with her arms out, then invites the man watching to sit in it too.
videos.said: Whoa, it sinks! Yay! Full circle!

videos.desc: A couple hangs a round wall clock in their kitchen, nudging it until it sits straight. The woman sets the hands, they lean in to hear it tick, then check the time and toast with their coffee mugs.

A woman clears a pile of clothes off a wooden desk, wipes the top clean, then sets it up with a lamp, laptop, pen cup, plant and notebook. She proudly sits down at the ready workspace next to a man, calling it her command post, while a cat walks across the desktop.

In a hand-drawn cartoon a cheerful couple carries moving boxes up the path into a yellow two-story house with a red roof and green door; the windows light up room by room and they fling open an upstairs window and wave their arms in joy.

Two young people explore a pitch-dark attic with a flashlight, its beam sweeping over a covered armchair and an old rocking horse. Then they open the window shutter and warm sunlight floods the whole room.

An animated shot filmed straight down onto a bed at night. A woman and a bearded man sleep on either side, with a small pug lying between them. The pug slowly stretches out and spreads its legs, pushing the two people further and further towards the edges of the bed. By the end the humans have been pushed off completely — only their hands still grip the sides of the mattress — and the pug lies alone, spread out flat in the exact middle of the bed.

A grey-blue front door swings open from the inside, showing the hallway of the house behind it: polished wooden floorboards, a carpeted staircase with a striped runner and pictures on the wall. A golden retriever puppy in a mint green bucket hat, a purple harness and a red lead comes trotting out of the hallway, over the threshold and down the brick front steps of the house. Outside, it walks along the pavement in the sunshine with its owner's legs and red lead beside it, past a wooden fence, front gardens and a parked car, tongue out and hat still on.

A small green cartoon lizard carries a white bowl of colourful star-shaped cereal across a dark living room to a big grey couch, licking its lips. It climbs up the side of the couch with the bowl, gets the bowl onto the cushion, then pulls itself up and settles into the corner of the couch. It tucks a plaid blanket around itself, picks up the remote control, and sits back against the cushions eating from the bowl with the light of the television flickering on its face.

Three short shots of people sitting down in different rooms. First a young man perches on a small pale upholstered chair in a bare corner of an empty room. Then an older woman lowers herself onto a large sofa piled with patterned cushions in a bright living room full of plants, a side table and a window seat. Finally an older man sinks back into a big brown leather armchair in a room lined with tall bookcases, stretching his legs out in front of him.

Three bedrooms one after another. The first is a small room whose walls are completely covered with band and film posters and fairy lights; a lad in a hoodie lies back on the bed next to an acoustic guitar. The second is a bare Japanese room with tatami mats, where a woman kneels and lays out a futon. The third is a grand wood-panelled bedroom where a man in a robe pulls open heavy curtains beside a four-poster bed.

Three very different bedrooms are put side by side. First a teenager's room with a poster-covered wall and two guitars, where a lad throws himself onto a narrow bed. Then a bare Japanese room with tatami mats, where a woman unfolds a white futon on the floor. Finally a dark luxury hotel bedroom with wood panelling, where a man in a robe opens the curtains onto a sea view and drops backwards onto the enormous bed.

An elderly man in a waistcoat and glasses cleans a crowded antique shop full of clocks. He beats a feather duster over a gilded mantel clock on a table, then reaches up and runs the duster along the wooden shelves of a tall bookcase packed with old books, small framed pictures and wall clocks. Clouds of grey dust rise into the light from the window and drift across the armchair in front of him.

A young woman kneels on the tiled floor of a small hostel room with bunk beds and digs frantically through a black backpack, pulling out handfuls of clothes and throwing them behind her. She lifts the mattress and pillow of the lower bunk and pushes her head under the bed frame to look underneath. A wide shot shows the whole room afterwards: clothes, caps and shoes lie scattered over the entire floor, from the door to the window, with almost no bare tiles left. She then sits in the middle of the scattered clothes holding a red passport, stares at it open-mouthed, and finally hugs it to her chest and laughs.

A young woman and a young man sit side by side on a dark green sofa in a plain living room, each holding a lit-up game controller and staring at the screen off camera. A blue bowl of crisps sits on the cushion between them. She jumps up onto the sofa with a fist in the air, cheering, and crisps scatter over the seat; he throws his head back laughing. They drop back down onto the cushions still playing.

A man in a green T-shirt works across a tall bare plasterboard wall in an attic room, rolling dark green paint onto it with a long-handled roller. Half the wall is already an even green block, the other half is still grey plasterboard with white filler stripes, and a dust sheet covers the floor at his feet.
videos.said: Look, you paint that big wall green so evenly.

videos.desc: A group of friends sit around a long wooden dining table by a bright window, covered with dishes: a whole roast chicken, a pizza in its box, bowls of salad, pasta and fries, a round loaf of bread and glasses of beer. They pass plates of grilled vegetables across the table to each other, one woman holds out a slice of pizza, hands tear pieces off the loaf, and the camera pulls back to show the whole laden table with everyone smiling and reaching over it.

A blue spin mop is pushed across beige kitchen tiles, leaving a wet shine between the grout lines. Cut to a woman in a grey shirt bending over a flat mop in a cream-tiled corridor. Then an older woman with white hair drags a wide dust mop down the aisle of a shop between shelves of bottles. Next a woman works a long-handled mop across the vast polished concrete of an empty warehouse, the ceiling lights reflected in it. Finally she sits down on the gleaming warehouse floor with her arms thrown wide.
videos.said: So clean. Got it. Almost there. Looking good.

videos.desc: A hand pushes down a door handle and opens a flat door. A young man with a backpack and a rolling suitcase steps into a narrow hallway; a golden retriever jumps up at him and he crouches to stroke it. An older woman in an apron comes out of the kitchen and they hug for several seconds while the dog sits at their feet. The last shot is a bedroom with a warm lamp and a bookshelf, where he drops backwards onto the bed and lies spread out on the quilt.

A teenage boy in mint-green pyjamas stands in a tiled bathroom in front of a white washbasin with a mirror, a shower cubicle and a towel rail. He brushes his teeth with a blue toothbrush, leans over the basin and spits, then lathers his hands with soap and rinses them under the tap, splashes water on his face, dries his face with a small towel and smiles at the camera.

An evening in a family living room. A young man sits on a grey corner sofa with a remote control in his hand, laughing at the television, while other people move around in the kitchen behind him. A red-haired woman runs in and flops down beside him, and a young man in a blue T-shirt sits down with a big bowl of popcorn. A woman brings a thick blue blanket over and spreads it across all four of them, and they settle in shoulder to shoulder under it, eating popcorn and watching the screen. A wall clock, a lamp, a picture and the kitchen are visible behind the sofa.

An elderly man in a patterned cardigan stands by a bright window holding up a small painting of a mountain valley in a silver moulded border, turning it so the camera can see it. He carries it to a hallway wall already filled with dozens of bordered landscape pictures, lifts it onto a hook and nudges the edges until it hangs straight among the others. He steps back and stands beside the finished wall, which runs the whole length of the hallway.

A young woman in a white t-shirt and jeans stands in a small yellow-walled room with a curtained window and an empty wooden bed frame, and pats a single white pillow down onto the bare slats. She then starts flinging brightly coloured pillows onto the frame one after another — pink, turquoise, yellow, green, cream — until they are heaped high above the bed. She walks up to the heap, laughing, and finally drops backwards into it so that only her face and one hand still show above the colours.

A girl in a mustard cardigan opens one door after another in an old house: a dark panelled study, a small yellow kitchen, a bedroom with a patchwork quilt on the bed, and finally a tall vaulted hall with arched windows, which she walks into and turns around in.

A woman films herself putting up and styling a set of floating oak shelves on a white wall. She runs her hand along a bare shelf, then stacks colourful hardback books in piles on the boards, stands a framed family photo in front of them, and sets a pale ceramic vase and a trailing pothos plant on the shelves. At the end she steps back and looks up at the finished wall of shelves full of books, frames and plants.

A man in a denim shirt is slouched deep into a brown armchair in a carpeted room, knees up and socked feet resting on the seat, talking to someone off camera. The shot cuts to a living room where he sits sunk into a patterned sofa beside a woman while a small boy leans against them. The room then fills: more and more people arrive and drop onto the sofas, sprawling across the cushions and each other, laughing, until the whole sectional is packed with a dozen or more friends lying back with their legs stretched out over the arms and over one another.

On a bright staircase in a house, a young woman with long braids, in a rust top, light jeans and white trainers, stands on the stairs pushing with both hands against a tall wooden wardrobe that is tipping over sideways. She reaches one arm up towards the landing, where a young man in a light blue T-shirt leans over the banister, reaches down to her, then comes down the stairs and grabs the top of the wardrobe. A rolled rug lies at the bottom, and plants, framed prints and a bicycle fill the hallway.

In an elegant living room with dark green patterned wallpaper, a white marble fireplace, a gold-framed landscape painting and glowing wall lamps, a smiling young woman in a burgundy jumper and cream trousers sits on a green velvet sofa. A golden cocker spaniel jumps up onto the sofa beside her, walks along the cushions, turns and lies down next to her, and she strokes its head. A mustard throw hangs off the arm, and a side table by the window holds a cup of tea and an open book.

A bright, elegant room for meals. A long polished wooden table is set with white plates, crystal glasses and brass candlesticks with lit candles, bowls of roast potatoes and green beans, and a dish of butter that a tabby cat sniffs. A young woman in a cream knitted dress comes through the door laughing, carrying a steaming roast chicken on a platter, and a young man in a navy jumper walks over laughing. A golden retriever with a napkin round its neck sits on a chair at the table.

A young woman with long dark hair, a grey long-sleeved nightshirt and thick knitted socks climbs from a rope ladder onto a bed built on a wooden platform high above a dark pine forest at dusk, hung from ropes under the branches of a tree. She crawls onto the bed, sits down, pulls a patchwork quilt over herself, lies back on the white pillows and closes her eyes. A small lantern glows warmly on the wooden headboard, and misty forested hills stretch away under a deep blue evening sky.

A big empty flat with pale green walls, tall windows and a wooden parquet floor on moving day. A young man lies flat on his back on a bare mattress in the middle of the room, hands folded on his stomach, not moving at all. Around him his friends are busy: a young woman carrying a potted plant steps right over him, a young woman in a lilac hoodie drops a cushion onto his face, and a young man in maroon bends to lift a sofa. Moving boxes, a rolled carpet, a lamp and a bicycle stand around.

An old, moss-stained aeroplane body turned into a home in a sunny pine forest. A young woman in a striped shirt and shorts stands barefoot on the wide wing, pegs a white sheet on a washing line and then sips from her mug. Tomato plants grow in pots beside the open doorway, rubber boots and a doormat sit by the entrance, and smoke rises from a chimney on the roof. A dog climbs up the wooden steps onto the wing past a parked bicycle, and a cyclist rides along a path behind.

A cosy wood-panelled living room. Three young friends slump lazily on a brown leather sofa doing nothing, their feet in white socks up on the coffee table: a young woman in a burgundy top, a young woman with braids in a lilac top, and a young man in a light blue shirt who yawns and leans back with his eyes closed. Behind them a young woman in green rushes past pulling a cable, and a grey cat moves along a shelf. Mugs and a crisp packet lie on the table.
